# What Vivado 2026.1 made of each design here, on xc7a100tftg256-1, from
# `FIXTURE=bram tools/vivado-parity/lutram.sh`. `routed` is its cell count
# after routing, `cell` each block RAM it left, `pin` each pin of the named
# cell `dut`, its net and the site pins that net reaches at the cell's site
# (lutram_probe.tcl), and `tile` each block RAM tile of its bitstream
# decoded through this repository's database:
# tests/fpga_xray_bram_vivado.rs says how to read one. A design with no
# lines but its name is one Vivado did not finish.
